end.summary:
Practised finding number partners that make 10.
Used fingers and counting to check pairs.
Answered 2 of 3 attempts without help.
Repeatedly said 5 and 5 was the only sure way; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 10 with fingers and counting forward. Gauri used these methods to identify some pairs, including 3 and 7 and 6 and 4. Gauri mixed up the idea by relying on 5 and 5 as the only pair, and this remained at the end. At home, show a ten-frame or ten small objects and practise one pair at a time, such as 8 and 2, then 7 and 3.
